title: What are JavaScript Modules?
overview: Modules allow developers to divide JavaScript code into multiple files. They help organize code, improve maintainability, and allow code reuse across applications.

example.title: Module Concept
example.content:
File 1:
Export code

File 2:
Import and use code

title: Exporting Modules
overview: The export keyword is used to make variables, functions, or classes available for use in other JavaScript files.

example.title: Export Example

title: Importing Modules
overview: The import keyword is used to bring exported code from another file into the current file.

title: Default Export
overview: A default export allows a file to export one main value. It does not require curly braces while importing.

example.title: Default Export Example
example.content:
export default App;

import App from './App';

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how JavaScript modules organize code using export and import statements, including named exports and default exports.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Modules split code into files.
✔ export shares code.
✔ import uses shared code.
✔ Default export exports one main value.
✔ Modules improve code organization.
